merger_description:
Stripe, LLC (**Stripe**) proposes to acquire 100% of the outstanding capital stock of OpenRouter Inc. (**OpenRouter**).

Stripe is a financial technology group active in the provision of payment processing and financial infrastructure software for businesses. Stripe’s services grant companies the ability to accept credit card payments, digital wallets, and global currency transactions. Stripe provides an AI gateway feature as part of a token billing service for Stripe customers.

OpenRouter is a technology company active within the wider artificial intelligence sector, in the provision of infrastructure services that facilitate access to Large Language Models and other generative AI models. OpenRouter’s business focuses on enabling access, comparison and use AI models from different providers through a single interface. The AI gateway is OpenRouter’s only product.

determination_table_content.details:
When making a determination in Phase 1, the Australian Competition
and Consumer Commission (ACCC) undertakes a competition
assessment and considers whether it is appropriate for an
acquisition to be approved or subject to further assessment in
Phase 2 in accordance with section 51ABZJ of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act). In doing so, the ACCC must have
regard to the object of the Act and all relevant matters, including the
interests of consumers.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notified acquisitions, see the ACCC’s merger assessment guidelines
and interim merger process guidelines.
In conducting its competition assessment, the ACCC has considered
the information and documents that were submitted with the
notification form and information from third parties.
The ACCC has determined that the Acquisition may be put into
effect as it considers that the Acquisition would be unlikely to have
the effect of substantially lessening competition in any market. In
reaching its decision, and based on the material before it, the ACCC
makes the following findings.
▪ The aggregation in the supply of AI Gateway services in Australia
as a result of the Acquisition is estimated to be low and Stripe’s
AI Gateway service is not a close competitor to OpenRouter’s
service.
▪ Post-Acquisition, the merged firm would continue to face
competition from other providers of AI Gateway services.
